==Senator Elections==
Each summit, a number of nations will elect [[Senator|senators]] for one or more of their territories to serve in the [[Senate]]. Each nation has a unique method of electing its senators. At the Autumn Equinox 388YE, the following nations will elect Senators on Saturday afternoon at the times listed in the table below, inside each nation's camp.
<table class="wikitable sortable mw-collapsible">
<tr><th>Nation</th><th>Time</th><th>Territories with Senator elections</th><th>Notes</th></tr>
<tr><td>[[The Brass Coast leadership|Brass Coast]]</td><td>1:00pm</td><td>[[Kahraman]]</td><td>Auction begins</td></tr>
<tr><td>[[Dawn leadership|Dawn]]</td><td>2:30pm</td><td>[[Semmerholm]]</td><td>Upon return from the [[Knight-protector#Appointment|grand tourney]]</td></tr>
<tr><td>[[Highguard leadership|Highguard]]</td><td>2:00pm</td><td>[[Casinea]]</td><td>Inquisition of candidates begins</td></tr>
<tr><td>[[The League leadership|League]]</td><td>3:30pm</td><td>[[Tassato]]</td><td>Presentation of collected bonds</td></tr>
<tr><td>[[The Marches leadership|Marches]]</td><td>1:30pm</td><td>[[Upwold]]</sup></td><td>[[Farm|Landowners]] gather</tr>
<tr><td>[[Urizen leadership|Urizen]]</td><td>1:00pm</td><td>[[Morrow]]</td><td>Demos begins (to conclude at 1:30pm)</td></tr>
<tr><td>[[Varushka leadership|Varushka]]</td><td>1:45pm</td><td>[[Volodmartz]]</td><td>Questioning of candidates begins</td></tr>
<tr><td>[[Wintermark political leadership|Wintermark]]</td><td>2:00pm</td><td>[[Hahnmark]]</td><td>Jars are placed down for 15 minutes</td></tr>
</table>

==Timetable==
This timetable and much more information can be seen on the notices that get pinned up all around the Hub after time-in. <br />
For any queries regarding the IC timetabling at events you can talk to the civil service staff in the Hub.

=== Citizen Bookings ===
Citizens can request to book Civil Service spaces, as detailed [[Anvil#Booking_Civil_Service_Spaces|here]]. Official meetings organised by the Civil Service are listed in darker shading, whilst such citizen-organised meetings are shown in a lighter colour, as below.

The names of individuals responsible for each booking are published on an in-character version of the timetable which will be available in the Hub throughout the event.
